offering_description.value: Manufactures portland cement at its Humboldt, Kansas plant and produces ready-mixed concrete, concrete products and aggregates. Sells to contractors, ready-mix producers, building material dealers and government road and construction projects, mainly in the central US.

primary_products.value: portland cement; ready-mixed concrete; concrete block and pavers; aggregates; fly ash and other cementitious materials

customer_segment.value: B2B: construction contractors, ready-mix producers, precast makers, building material dealers; B2G: state and local highway and public works projects

end_markets.value: construction; highway and infrastructure; residential building; commercial building; oil and gas well cementing

revenue_model.value: product sales: cement, ready-mixed concrete, concrete products and aggregates sold by volume

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: quarries limestone and makes cement and concrete products, sold to contractors and ready-mix customers; distributor: resells building materials and aggregates through its own distribution operations

geography_served.value: US regional: Kansas, Missouri, Nebraska, Iowa, Oklahoma, Colorado and surrounding central states

specialization.value: related lines: cement, ready-mixed concrete, concrete products, aggregates and building materials

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: cement and concrete sold directly to contractors and ready-mix customers; own locations: ready-mix plants and building material yards

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental and air emissions rules from EPA and state agencies, MSHA quarry safety, OSHA

notes: Details on current segments and states served are from memory and may be slightly outdated.
